subject: Initial MAPlet template + Week0 playbook (HealthSync pilot)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Christina Taylor <ctaylor@healthsync.io>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@healthsync.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, May 14, 2028 at 9:12 AM PDT
Subject: Initial MAPlet template + Week0 playbook (HealthSync pilot)

Hi Christina / Tom —

Great to meet briefly on Friday. Per our conversation I put together a compact MAP template ("MAPlet") focused on a 30‑60 day pilot and a Week0 playbook to drive a fast technical validation. Attached: HS_MAPlet_Week0_Playbook.gdoc and a starter slide deck (MAPlet_Slides_v1.pptx).

High‑level asks:
- Can you review the acceptance criteria under "Security & Data" and the "SLO matrix"?
- Please flag any stakeholders who must attend the Week0 workshop (we recommend Product + Eng + Security + Platform).
- If you’re available, can we take 30 minutes next week to walk the doc and align roles? I proposed Wed 5/16 10:00 AM PT but flexible.

Quick notes on scope in the doc:
- Pilot scope: inference endpoints only (no training).
- Data handling: sample payloads + retention notes included.
- Success metrics: latency @ P95, cost per 1k tokens, functional coverage for 8 canonical prompts.

Link to the working doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1HSlk_example_MAPlet_week0 (edit access granted to your domain).

Thanks — looking forward to your feedback.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwood.com

From: Christina Taylor <ctaylor@healthsync.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, May 14, 2028 at 11:30 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Initial MAPlet template + Week0 playbook (HealthSync pilot)

Thanks Vanessa — this looks like a useful starting point. A couple quick asks from our side:

- Can we add a short "Security gating" checklist (SOC2 scope, KMS usage, audit log access) as a first page? Our InfoSec will need that before any demos.
- The SLOs are great — can you also include a target for token throughput (requests/sec) so our infra team can estimate capacity?
- For stakeholder slides: would prefer a single‑slide "decision owner + success criteria" we can paste into our exec pack. If you can share a Slides link I'll drop names.

Wed 5/16 10:00 AM PT works for us — please send calendar invite.

Appreciate the concise layout.

—
Christina Taylor
Director of Product, HealthSync
ctaylor@healthsync.io

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Christina Taylor <ctaylor@healthsync.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, May 15, 2028 at 8:45 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Initial MAPlet template + Week0 playbook (HealthSync pilot)

Thanks Christina — great feedback. I made the following updates in the live doc (linked below):

- Added a "Security gating" checklist page with SOC2 scoping items, KMS integration notes, and required access for audit exports.
- Expanded the SLO matrix to include token throughput (RPS), P95 latency, and a simple cost estimate line for 10k and 100k tokens.
- Created a single‑slide "Decision owner & success criteria" in the Slides deck for your exec pack.

Please review the two highlighted sections: 1) "Data retention & export" and 2) "Target RPS by pilot day" — those are where your security and infra teams often have clarifying questions.

Working doc (updated): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1HSlk_example_MAPlet_week0
Slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1HSslides_MAPlet_v1
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/HS-2028-0937

For the workshop attendees, please confirm these roles:
- Christina Taylor (Product)
- Tom Nguyen (Engineering)
- Security lead (name?)
- Platform/Cloud ops (name?)

Marissa / Ben / Jasmine — looping you in to own the Week0 agenda and the short demo (10 minutes) that shows inference latency/cost tradeoffs. Can one of you take the slide for "SLO targets"?

I’ll send a calendar invite for Wed 5/16 10:00 AM PT and include a short pre‑read.

—
Vanessa

From: Christina Taylor <ctaylor@healthsync.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@healthsync.io>
Date: Thu, May 16, 2028 at 3:48 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Initial MAPlet template + Week0 playbook (HealthSync pilot)

On Wed, May 15, 2028 at 8:45 AM Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com> wrote:
> For the workshop attendees, please confirm these roles:
> - Christina Taylor (Product)
> - Tom Nguyen (Engineering)
> - Security lead (name?)
> - Platform/Cloud ops (name?)

Thanks Vanessa — confirmed. Attendee list attached (HealthSync_Attendee_List.csv). Our Security lead (Priya Menon) and Platform lead (Ravi Shah) will join. We reviewed the Security gating page and added two items: a short note about allowed data subclasses and an IP allowlist request for the pilot.

Wed 5/16 10:00 AM PT still good for the session — Tom will present infra capacity constraints and Priya will cover the gating checklist. We’ll plan to validate the four acceptance prompts during the session.

Looking forward to the workshop — I’ll add names to your slide and accept the calendar invite.

—
Christina
